main_text.p: פעמות[?] f.p. Anguli, juxta Kimchium, R.Levi & Chaldaeum. Aff. יעמותיו[?], 1.Reg.7.30. Quidam, Pedes, Bafes: alii Impages reddunt.
פַּעֲמֹן m. Tintinabulum, Exod.28.34. sic dictum, quod Concussione persónet: Plural. פַּעֲמֹנִים את Tintinabula, Exod.39.25. Conftruct. זְהַב פַּעֲמֹנֵי Tintinabula auri, Exod.28.33.

פָּעַר Aperuit, Diftendit, & ori peculiariter tribuitur: Praeter. פָּעַרְתִּי[?] Os meum diftendi, Pfal.119.131. פָּעֲרוּ Diftenderunt contra me בְּפִיהֶם ore suo, i.e. os suum, Job.16.10. & ב redundat. Vide Job.29.23. Jefa.5.14.

פָּצַח Aperuit, Pandit, Dilatavit, Diduxit, Diffendit: Et ex usu Chaldaico, Liberavit: Praeterit. פָּצִיתָ אֶת־פִּיךָ Pandisti os tuum, Jud.11.36. פָּצְתָה אֶת פִּיהָ Aperuit os suum, Gen.4.11. Partic. הַפֹּצֶה Qui liberat Davidem, Pfal.144.10. Jonathan פַּצֵּנִי. Imper. פַּצֵּנִי Libera me, v.11. Jonath. פַּצִּי יְתִי.

פָּצַח Fragorem, Sonum edidit, Perfonuit: Praeterit. פָּצְחוּ רִנָּה Fragorem ediderunt cantu, Jefa. 14. v.7. Imper. פִּצְחוּ Fragorem edite montes cantu, Jefa.44.23. Pih. פִּצַּח Diffregit, proprie cum fragore & fonitu. Praeter. עַצְמוֹתֵיהֶם פִּצַּחוּ Offa eorum diffringunt, Mich.3.3.
פָּצַל Pih. Decorticavit: Praeter. פִּצֵּל Genef.30.38. Futur. וַיְפַצֵּל בָּהֶן Et decorticavit in eis, v.37.
פָּצַם Diffregit: Praeter. פִּצַּמְתָּה Diffregisti eam, Pfal.60.4. Sic in Targum, פִּצִּים לֵיהּ חַרְכִּין Et perfregit sibi fenestras, Jer.22.14.
פָּצַע Vulneravit: Praeterit. פָּצְעוּנִי Vulnerarunt me, Cant.5.7. Partic. Praeter. פָּצוּעַ דָּכָא[?] Vulneratus contusione, Deut.23.1. Inf. פָּצֹעַ Et vulnerado, 1.Reg.20.37.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some headword forms are doubtful and marked [?]. The Hebrew in the Chaldee and Targum references (e.g. פִּצִּים לֵיהּ) and the form in the Jud.11.36 and Pfal.60.4 lines may contain small errors. Scan is faint at the right edge of several Hebrew lines.
